The '''Battle of Ziost''' was a conflict of the [[Great Galactic War]] fought between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battle occurred shortly after the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] pulled its [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] away from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and instead stationed them in orbit of the ancient Imperial world of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. The [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]], led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Angral]] and [[Darth Malgus]], struck against the intruders in an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] attack. The battle lasted over thirty days, and was primarily waged in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and low [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] orbit. Although the Empire ultimately managed to chase the Republic away, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] [[Battle of Ashas Ree|struck again]] immediately afterwards on the Sith world [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]].
